election: Election of deputy (part-time) judges of the Federal Supreme Court by the Federal Assembly
role_sought: Deputy judge of the Federal Supreme Court (juge fédéral suppléant)
detail: His Federal Supreme Court biography lists him as a deputy judge of the Court from 2019 to 2023 but does not give the date of the election. Deputy judges of the federal courts are elected by the United Federal Assembly, separately from full-time judges, according to the Federal Assembly.

election: Election of a judge of the Federal Supreme Court by the United Federal Assembly
role_sought: Judge of the Federal Supreme Court (juge fédéral)
detail: Elected a federal judge on 15 March 2023, according to his Federal Supreme Court biography, which lists his party as the Centre. The United Federal Assembly (both chambers sitting together) elects federal judges by secret ballot for a six-year term, on proposals prepared by its Judicial Committee; vacancies arising during a term are filled for the rest of that term. The vote count recorded in the Federal Assembly's Official Bulletin is not reproduced here.
